welcome.title: Kleer It
welcome.body: RoadKleer uses GPS to mark the spot
welcome.note: (stamps placed more than .25 miles from actual roadkill may result in tax-dollar waste)
welcome.footer: Drive with RoadKleer open for best results.

domestic.pill: If you feel that your roadkill stamp marks the spot of a lost pet, please consider calling the local authorities.
domestic.title: We acknowledge how devastating it can be to lose a pet.
domestic.body: We are purportedly contracted with local roadkill removal personnel, not equipped to handle the loss of pets. For pets, we know you'll do the right thing. Drive safely.
